01 / ARRIVAL

A considered arrival

Concierge, registration and wayfinding greet visitors at the entrance. Four open modules use low furniture to preserve the sightline to the stage.

02 / CONVERSATION

Space for better conversations

Sofas, consultation tables and a coffee bar sit toward the front half of the hall, creating a place to pause and talk away from the seated audience.

03 / DESTINATION

A destination in clear view

An 8 × 3 m stage anchors the rear, with a main screen, AV control and a crew-only backstage area. No sales booths sit behind the stage.

Design assumptions and venue checks

This is a spatial design concept, not a construction drawing or an approved sales plan. It assumes a 50 × 20 m hall envelope from the reference image. The 4.8 m ceiling height, 0.45 m stage height, 2 m backstage zone and 48 seats are proposals. Confirm usable floor area, doors, columns, building services, escape routes, stage accessibility and approved capacity with the venue.

Original sale-module IDs are retained: 01–13, 15–18 and 20–34, totalling 32 modules. IDs 14 and 19 are not sales booths. This proposal replaces the three-wall arrangement with 28 perimeter modules and 4 open modules. Categories and fit-outs are illustrative; no exhibitor bookings are implied.

Event dates and venue sourced from propertyexpophuket.com (checked 11 October 2026). Venue imagery and logo are from the PPX website. The model shows a visitor tour route, not an evacuation plan.
